summary: The exact candidate fixes global-rank CUDA device selection and coordinates GDS fallback and fatal copy errors across the process group before FilesBufferOnDevice tensor broadcasts. Base and prior-candidate failures were reproduced; candidate regressions, independent two-rank adversarial cases, and real fastsafetensors GPU data movement passed.

tests.what_was_measured: The prepared base failed local-device selection (cuda:11 instead of cuda:0) and asymmetric GDS fallback; two of three tests failed.
Reproduced the prior review counterexample: only the rank with the GDS error retried nogds, recording [(0, false), (1, false), (1, true)].
All seven candidate fastsafetensors regressions passed, including local-device selection and coordinated two-rank Gloo fallback.

Two real Gloo ranks handled asymmetric constructor-time GDS failure, completed a post-fallback broadcast on both ranks, and stopped both ranks before broadcast for asymmetric non-GDS and nogds-retry failures.

tests.what_was_measured: Real fastsafetensors loaded a 4x4 float32 safetensor to AMD gfx950 with max absolute error 0 and sum 120 matching the CPU reference.

tests.what_was_measured: With GDS requested, real fastsafetensors detected missing /dev/nvidia-fs0, selected its nogds copier, and loaded 257 float32 values to gfx950 with max absolute error 0.

gpu_evidence: Real fastsafetensors 0.4.0 tensor loads ran on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- and matched independent CPU tensors exactly; see raw/real_fastsafetensors_nogds_gpu.log and raw/real_fastsafetensors_gds_requested_gpu.log.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU and one node were available; the reported multi-node NVIDIA GDS/NCCL deployment was not run.
GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable, so the exact full-model serving deployment and model semantics remain unverified.
The prepared interpreter had no installed fastsafetensors package; real-package checks used an unpacked 0.4.0 wheel outside the checkout.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
